answer_2.quote: We consider two metrics to measure the similarity of the generated and the ground-truth melodies: Similarity of pitch and duration distribution (PD and DD) and Melody distance (MD). Besides, we use accuracy of tonality, chord, rhythm pattern, and cadence (TA, CA, RA, AA) to measure the consistency between the generated melody and musical elements in the template.

answer_4.quote: We invite 10 participants (including 7 amateurs and 3 professionals) as human annotators to evaluate 10 songs in each language. ... we use following subjective metrics to evaluate the generated melodies: 1) Harmony: Is the melody itself harmonious? 2) Rhythm: Is the rhythm sounds natural and suitable for lyrics? 3) Structure: Does the melody consist of repetitive and impressive segments? 4) Quality: What is the overall quality of the melody?
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated each melody on a five-point scale from 1 (Poor) to 5 (Perfect) for each of the four criteria.
